description: Hand-derived canonical test vectors for updated Nutri-Score scoring engines (TypeScript and Python). Covers all acceptance cases, boundaries, route exceptions, and abstentions.

vectors.description: Standard general food (lentil meal) with moderate nutrients resulting in Grade A

reasons.text: Energy of 450 kJ contributes 1 adverse point(s) out of 10.
Total sugars of 4.0 g contribute 1 adverse point(s) under the European reference algorithm.
Saturated fatty acids of 0.5 g contribute 0 adverse point(s) out of 10.
Salt content of 0.8 g contributes 3 adverse point(s) out of 20.
Protein content of 6.0 g contributes 2 favourable point(s).
Dietary fibre content of 4.5 g contributes 2 favourable point(s) out of 5.
Fruits, vegetables and legumes content of 65.0% contributes 2 favourable point(s).

vectors.acceptanceCase: Case 2 & 6: General food exact threshold boundary
vectors.description: Values exactly equal to lower thresholds: operator > requires strict exceedance, so all points remain 0

reasons.text: Energy of 335 kJ contributes 0 adverse point(s) out of 10.

vectors.acceptanceCase: Case 2 & 6: General food strictly above threshold
vectors.description: Values strictly above thresholds by small epsilon: each component earns 1 point

reasons.text: Salt content of 0.21 g contributes 1 adverse point(s) out of 20.

vectors.acceptanceCase: Case 2: Protein conditional rule when Points A >= 11
vectors.description: Snack food with Points A = 21 (>= 11) where protein points (3) are NOT subtracted; only fibres (1) subtracted, resulting in Score 20 (Grade E)

reasons.text: Protein content of 8.0 g contributes 3 favourable point(s).

trace.ruleLocator: 2022 Report p. 132 (Points A >= 11 and not cheese -> A - (Fibres + FVL))

vectors.acceptanceCase: Case 2: Cheese exception to the protein conditional rule
vectors.description: Cheese product with Points A = 22 (>= 11). Because product is cheese, all 7 protein points ARE subtracted: Score = 22 - 7 = 15 (Grade D). Hand-verified against Belgian calculator sheet 'Cheese' row 3.

reasons.text: Cheese route: favourable points (including protein) are subtracted without the 11-point adverse limit.

vectors.acceptanceCase: Case 2: Red meat protein point cap of 2 points
vectors.description: Raw beef tenderloin with 23.7g protein (would earn 7 points without cap). Red meat rule caps protein at 2 points: Score = 1 - 2 = -1 (Grade A). Hand-verified against Belgian calculator sheet 'Red meat' row 3.

reasons.text: Protein content of 23.7 g in red meat is capped at 2 favourable point(s).

trace.ruleLocator: 2022 Report p. 131, Section 1.2.1 (Red meat cap: 2 pts)

vectors.acceptanceCase: Case 2 & 6: Fats/nuts/seeds route with ratio and FVL oils
vectors.description: Extra virgin olive oil: energy from saturates (14g * 37 = 518 kJ -> 4 pts), saturates ratio (14/100 = 14% -> 1 pt), 100% olive oil FVL (5 pts). Points A = 5 < 7 -> Score = 5 - 5 = 0 (Grade B).

reasons.text: Saturated fatty acids ratio to total lipids (14.0%) contributes 1 adverse point(s) out of 10.

trace.ruleLocator: 2022 Report p. 135, Section 2.1 (Score 0 is in -5..2 -> Grade B)

vectors.acceptanceCase: Case 2: Fats route protein conditional rule when Points A >= 7
vectors.description: Nut spread with Points A = 10 (>= 7). Protein points (7) are NOT subtracted; only fibres (4) are subtracted. Score = 10 - 4 = 6 (Grade C).

reasons.text: Protein content of 25.0 g contributes 7 favourable point(s).

trace.ruleLocator: 2022 Report p. 135, Section 2.4 (Points A >= 7 -> A - (Fibres + FVL))

vectors.description: Supported plain water is classified as Grade A automatically without calculation.

reasons.text: Water is classified as Grade A automatically under the European reference algorithm.

trace.ruleLocator: 2023 Report p. 75, Section 1.4 & Table 'Final Nutri-Score thresholds'

vectors.acceptanceCase: Case 6: Extreme beverage vector with 0 adverse points, max favourable points (-18 score floor)
vectors.description: Beverage with Points A = 0 and maximum favourable Points C = 18 (Protein 7, Fibres 5, FVL 6). Score = 0 - 18 = -18 (Grade B). Note that water is Grade A, while non-water beverages with Score <= 2 receive Grade B.

reasons.text: Protein content of 3.5 g contributes 7 favourable point(s).
Dietary fibre content of 7.8 g contributes 5 favourable point(s) out of 5.
Fruits, vegetables and legumes content of 85.0% contributes 6 favourable point(s).

trace.ruleLocator: 2023 Report p. 74, Section 1.3 (Score = Points A - Points C: 0 - 18 = -18)

vectors.acceptanceCase: Case 2: Beverage non-nutritive sweetener +4 adverse points
vectors.description: Diet soft drink with zero sugar and energy, containing aspartame: +4 adverse points for sweetener. Score = 4 - 0 = 4 (Grade C).

reasons.text: Presence of authorized non-nutritive sweetener adds 4 adverse points in the beverage calculation route.

trace.ruleLocator: 2023 Report p. 75, Table 'Final Nutri-Score thresholds' (Score 4 is in 3..6 -> Grade C)

vectors.description: Values exactly at thresholds: energy = 30 kJ (<= 30 -> 0), sugars = 0.5g (<= 0.5 -> 0), saturates = 1.0g (<= 1.0 -> 0), salt = 0.2g (<= 0.2 -> 0). Score = 0 (Grade B).

reasons.text: Energy of 30 kJ contributes 0 adverse point(s) out of 10.

trace.ruleLocator: 2023 Report p. 75, Table 'Final Nutri-Score thresholds' (Score 0 is <= 2 -> Grade B)

vectors.acceptanceCase: Case 3: Missing required field yields insufficient_data abstention
vectors.description: General food product missing mandatory fibre declaration: scoring engine must withhold grade and report missing_fibre issue

issues.message: Fibre is not available for this calculation.

vectors.acceptanceCase: Case 3: Unknown/unsupported category yields insufficient_data abstention
vectors.description: Product category cannot be determined or routed into supported categories: engine must not silently apply general food rules

issues.message: Product category is not supported for Nutri-Score calculation.

vectors.acceptanceCase: Case 3 & 6: Beverage with unknown sweetener presence yields insufficient_data abstention
vectors.description: Beverage whose sweetener presence is unknown (“unknown presence is not absence”, 05-scoring.md): scoring engine must withhold grade and report sweetener_presence_unknown issue

issues.message: Sweetener presence is unknown; cannot determine beverage adverse points under updated 2023 algorithm.
